tools.description: The leader accepts (T2, T3 → landed) or rejects (back to T1 with the reason) a reported task unit (board.mjs accept). Refused to a session that does not lead today, is the assignee, or ever claimed the unit; refused while a commit since the assign changed the scope unreported. A gate_by=owner unit needs `gate`: the owner's words typed in THIS (the leader's) session.

gate.description: The owner's words, verbatim, as they typed them or chose them in an AskUserQuestion in THIS session (join several answers from one message with ||; no part may be blank). Passed as --gate=…; board.mjs finds the message and proves the words are in it — a part under 8 characters only as a whole line of that message. The wrapper never takes --words/--session/--uuid.
